Facts: Using software (fiddler) to intercept and manipulate payment platform, illegally withdraw money from a fintech app. This is theft (盗窃) via computer. Could be "非法获取金融账户信息" or "诈骗"? Actually they are stealing money by hacking, not fraud. The appropriate charge is "盗窃罪" (theft) or "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪"? Chinese law: Article 224 (theft) includes theft of public or private property. Using computer to steal money may be considered "盗窃罪" or "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (Article 285). However typical classification for hacking to steal money is "盗窃罪" (theft) or "诈骗罪"? They used secret means to obtain money from the platform. The description: "非法窃取锦米袋公司支付平台内人民币". That is theft. Also they taught others the method, which could be "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (helping others commit computer crimes) or "组织、领导、帮助网络犯罪活动罪". In Chinese law, there is a specific offense: "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (Article 293 of Criminal Law). The facts: He taught others the method, and they used it to steal money. So he could be charged with "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". Also his own theft is "盗窃罪".
